notes: The Item 7 (targeted) section provided was empty, so scoring rests on Item 1 only. The Community Partnerships section gives no dollar amounts or participant counts for any program, and the 16,000-tree figure was judged not enough to show substantial reach. The Pecos Watershed Conservation Initiative support is environmental conservation, not community or education, so it was not recorded. Engagement with educational institutions is described as recruitment, so it was not counted. U.S. benefits include parental leave for birth and adoption and fertility/family-building benefits. These were not counted as cross-cultural inclusion because the filing does not describe them as aimed at any underrepresented group, and the lower level was chosen when torn. The Technical Excellence Initiative is only an initial framework with broader implementation planned for 2026, and the IDP framework has just begun, so both are folded into E1 employee development. Mandatory compliance, cybersecurity and HSE training were excluded.
